examples.arabic: هي عايزة كتاب "ألف ليلة وليلة" اللي كان بـ ٨٠ جنيه، بس معاها ٥٠ جنيه بس.
examples.english: She wanted "One Thousand and One Nights" book, which was 80 EGP, but she only had 50 EGP.
examples.transliteration: Heya 3ayza ketab "Alf Leila we Leila" elly kan be-80 geneh, bas ma'aha 50 geneh bas.
examples.storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book
